heading: About Me
content:
A data-driven professional bridging financial markets and higher education. I am currently a Teaching Assistant at Hong Kong Baptist University's School of Business, supporting data-intensive postgraduate programmes, and I bring recent hands-on experience in fintech content and community operations at Futu (moomoo). I work fluently in full-English environments and apply a quantitative, analytical approach across both finance and teaching.

Finance & Investment: My financial-market exposure spans fintech operations and research focused on equities and ETFs. At Futu's moomoo platform, I curated daily trending-stock lists across US-led English-speaking markets (US, Singapore, Australia, Malaysia), synthesised macro-policy and market-moving developments into user-facing summaries, and tracked top movers such as NVDA, PLTR, AVGO and BTC. Engaging daily with an active options-trading user base also gave me a working understanding of options strategies and their role in market flows. Earlier internships sharpened my command of market data — using Python (Pandas), SQL and Tableau to automate market data extraction, build performance dashboards, and author periodic research reports.

Higher Education & Teaching Support: As a Teaching Assistant, I have helped deliver and tutor MSc-level courses including Big Data Analytics with Python, Artificial Intelligence in Business, Cloud Computing for Business Analytics, and Econometrics. I specialise in translating complex data and coding concepts into clear, practical guidance, while managing the administrative and communication side of course delivery through Moodle, BUniPort and formal university correspondence.

Full-English Working Proficiency: I operate end-to-end in English across both roles — engaging English-speaking markets and communities at Futu and working in an English-medium academic environment at HKBU — complemented by Mandarin and Cantonese for multicultural coordination. My double MSc in Operational Research & Business Statistics and Business Analytics (HKBU / University of Kent) anchors this with a strong quantitative and analytical foundation.
